name: Boom Grid
description: Minesweeper for people who like it fast: compact cells, a live counter, a stopwatch and per-level records. Supports the full set of classic controls, including safe openings and chording, plus a resume of the board you left half finished. Everything runs in the popup - no servers, no sign-in, no trackers.

browser_action.default_title: Boom Grid — Sweep it before it blows
